book.name: OLPHONG
book.title: JOHAN KAH OLPHONG (The Revelation to John)

content: Babylon ham Vaan kah Kokhah
Hekah phoeiah vaan ah hlangping a yet kah ol bangla muep ka yaak. “Haleluijah, khangnah, thangpomnah, neh thaomnah tah mamih Pathen kah ni,” a ti uh.
A laitloeknah tah thuem tih dueng. A Cukhalnah neh diklai aka poeih hlanghalh koek te lai a tloek thil. A sal rhoek kah thii te hlanghalh kut lamloh a suk coeng.
Te phoeiah a pabae la, “Haleluijah a hmaikhu te kumhal kah kumhal la khu,” a ti.
Patong rhoek pakul pali neh mulhing pali tah bakop uh tih ngolkhoel sokah aka ngol Pathen te a bawk uh. Te vaengah, “Amen Haleluijah,” a ti uh.
Ngolkhoel lamkah aka lo ol long khaw, “Boeipa kah sal rhoek boeih neh amah aka rhih a yet a len rhoek mamih kah Pathen te thangthen uh,” a ti.
Tuca kah Yuluei Hlaembuh
Te phoeiah hlingping ol bangla muep ka yaak. Tui puei ol bangla, rhaek ol bangla bahoeng cai. “Halleluijah, mamih Boeipa Pathen tloengkhoelh loh a poeng coeng.
Omngaih uh sih lamtah hlampan sih. Amah te thangpomnah pae uh sih. Tuca kah yulueinah tah ha pawk coeng tih a yuu amah tah rhuengphong uh coeng,” a ti uh.
Hnithen a cim thik bai sak ham khaw amah a paek coeng. Te hnithen tah hlangcim rhoek kah rhilam ni.
Te phoeiah kai taengah “Tuca kah yuluei hlaembuh la a khue rhoek te a yoethen uh,” tila daek lah a ti. Te phoeiah kai taengah “Hekah he Pathen kah olka taktak ni,” a ti.

Te vaengah anih te bawk ham a kho kung ah ka bakop. Tedae ka taengah, “Nan hmu mahnim. Kai khaw nang neh Jesuh kah olphong aka khueh na manuca kah sal puei ni. Jesuh kah olphong tah tonghma ol kah mueihla la a om dongah Pathen mah bawk,” a ti.
Marhang Bok ah aka Ngol
Te phoeiah vaan a ong te ka hmuh. Te vaengah marhang bok lawt ha thoeng. A soah aka ngol tah uepom neh oltak la a khue. Te dongah duengnah neh lai a tloek tih a vathoh.
A mik tah hmai bangla tak tih a lu ah lukhuem muep om. Anih ah Ming daek la aka om te amah pawt atah a ming uh moenih.
Thii dongah a nuem himbai a bai tih a ming tah Pathen kah olka la a khue.
Amah te vaan kah rhalkap loh marhang bok neh a vai uh tih hnithen a bok thik te a bai uh.
A ka lamkah thunglang haat aka thoeng neh namtom rhoek te a tloek vetih amih te thi conghol neh a dawndah ni. Anih loh Tloengkhoelh Pathen kah kosi thinsanah misurtui kah misur rhom te khaw a til.
Manghai rhoek kah Manghai neh Boei rhoek kah Boeipa tila ming pakhat te himbai neh a phai ah daek tangtae te khaw a khueh.
Satlung kah Caemthoh te Yawk
Te phoeiah khomik dongah aka pai puencawn pakhat ka hmuh. Te vaengah ol ue la pang tih vaan bangli kah aka ding vathawt rhoek boeih te, “Pathen kah hlaembuh puei la tun halo uh.

Manghai rhoek kah a saa neh rhalboeipa rhoek kah a saa khaw, hlangtlung rhoek kah a saa khaw, marhang neh a soah aka ngol rhoek kah saa khaw, aka loeih neh sal rhoek a yit a len boeih kah a saa khaw ca uh,” a ti.
Te phoeiah satlung neh diklai manghai rhoek khaw, amih kah rhalkap rhoek khaw, marhang dongkah aka ngol neh a rhalkap rhoek te caem tloek ham a tingtun uh te ka hmuh.

Tedae satlung neh a hmaiah miknoek aka saii laithae tonghma tah a tuuk coeng. Te nen te satlung kah kutnoek aka dang rhoek neh a muei aka bawk rhoek te a rhaithi coeng.Te dongah kat neh aka ung hmai tuili ah a hing la bok a voeih.
A tloe rhoek tah marhang soah aka ngol kah thunglang, a ka lamkah aka thoeng nen te a ngawn. Te vaengah a saa te vathawt boeih loh hah uh.
